title: Board A/B power and protection contract is not bounded
component_interface: Board B 12 V protection and 5 V feed; Board A analog/digital rails
description: The product requires protected 12 V entry, 12 V-to-5 V conversion, local low-noise rails and hardware fault behavior but does not give full load, tolerance, sequencing, threshold or peak-current limits. Schematic readiness requires a worst-case power contract independent of old circuits.

evidence.note: Power/protection functions are required, but exact rail and protection limits are not supplied.
Device-driven rail classes and sequencing constraints documented; converter, protection and full current margins remain R4 open.
R3 reviewed this finding; its existing blocker phase and required external/R4 evidence remain open.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: NXP HW Guide Rev 7 pp.2-6 now supplies current DCDC, sequence and decoupling guidance; owner removes PoC 10-A assumption. Selected regulators/protection and guaranteed rail/load/threshold budgets remain open.

closure_criterion: Before R4 PASS, document Board B input/protected rail and 5 V envelopes, Board A rail sources/loads, peak/transient current, return-contact budget, protection thresholds, startup/shutdown and fault states; support all bounds with R2 device evidence and worst-case calculation. Do not copy legacy rails or supervisor networks.
